title: Pass compatible methods directly to delegates
goal: Pass a compatible F# method to a .NET delegate; retain adapters when arguments need transformation.

selectionNotes: Direct spelling already works on F# 10; 11.0 labels compiler lowering.

prerequisites: Use an F# net11.0 executable or library, .NET 11 SDK, FSharp.Core 11 and LangVersion=11.0.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use the .NET 11 SDK and its F# compiler for the declared target.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This verified edition targets net11.0; the .NET 10 sample is a comparison, not an older-target catalogue route.

language.name: F#
language.reason: Compiled in stable F# 11 language mode.

constraints: Direct construction is signature-dependent; this example uses a curried static method and Func<int,int,int>. Do not assume every tupled or overloaded method has the same conversion.
Automatic compiler closure optimizations do not require rewriting clear working code. No allocation benchmark is claimed.
Direct spelling predates F# 11; introduction 11.0 identifies newer compiler lowering, not syntax availability. Existing direct calls need no rewrite.

packages.name: FSharp.Core
packages.reason: FSharp.Core 11 is the library dependency for this edition; the exact compiled RC2 version is recorded separately in evidence.

evidence.scope: Actual FSharpApi compilation and managed execution including delegates assertions; separate compiler/external-consumer probes in eng/Test-FSharpBoundaries.ps1. No mocks, cross-compilation, native/AOT deployment or GA execution claimed.
